name: Avernus
title: Avernus: The First Layer
description: Avernus is the first layer of the Nine Hells, a rocky wasteland with rivers of blood and clouds of biting flies, serving as the arrival point for visitors and the front line of the Blood War.
wiki: Avernus is a charred, desolate wasteland littered with the debris of a thousand wars. It is the domain of Zariel, who commands the infernal legions against the demon hordes of the Abyss.
